info.title: Foundational View Classes - API Contract
info.description: C++23 API contracts for android::view View, ViewGroup, ViewParent, ViewManager, LayoutParams, MeasureSpec. This is a C++ header-level API specification, not a network API.

Visibility.notes: Preserves Java-ABI-compatible integer values per Constitution Principle I.

MeasureSpec.description: Packed mode + size. Mode in top 2 bits, size in bottom 30 bits.

View.inheritance_style: public virtual via CRTP mixins (private inheritance)

methods.name: get_visibility
methods.description: Returns current visibility state.

methods.name: set_visibility
methods.description: Sets visibility. Triggers layout pass if changed to/from GONE.
methods.side_effects: Triggers requestLayout() if new visibility is GONE and old was not.

methods.name: get_id
methods.description: Returns the view ID. Default is NO_ID (-1).

methods.name: set_id
methods.description: Sets the view ID.

methods.name: get_tag
methods.description: Returns the associated tag, or std::nullopt if none set.

methods.name: set_tag
methods.description: Associates an arbitrary object with this view.

methods.name: get_alpha
methods.description: Returns alpha value in range [0.0, 1.0]. Default 1.0.

methods.name: set_alpha
methods.description: Sets alpha transparency. Clamped to [0.0, 1.0].

methods.name: get_rotation
methods.description: Returns rotation around Z axis in degrees.

methods.name: set_rotation
methods.description: Sets rotation around Z axis in degrees.

methods.name: get_rotation_x
methods.description: Returns rotation around X axis in degrees.

methods.name: set_rotation_x
methods.description: Sets rotation around X axis in degrees.

methods.name: get_rotation_y
methods.description: Returns rotation around Y axis in degrees.

methods.name: set_rotation_y
methods.description: Sets rotation around Y axis in degrees.

methods.name: get_rotation_z
methods.description: Returns rotation around Z axis in degrees.

methods.name: set_rotation_z
methods.description: Sets rotation around Z axis in degrees.

methods.name: get_scale_x
methods.description: Returns scale factor on X axis. Default 1.0.

methods.name: set_scale_x
methods.description: Sets scale factor on X axis.

methods.name: get_scale_y
methods.description: Returns scale factor on Y axis. Default 1.0.

methods.name: set_scale_y
methods.description: Sets scale factor on Y axis.

methods.name: get_translation_x
methods.description: Returns X offset from layout position in pixels. Default 0.

methods.name: set_translation_x
methods.description: Sets X offset from layout position in pixels.

methods.name: get_translation_y
methods.description: Returns Y offset from layout position in pixels. Default 0.

methods.name: set_translation_y
methods.description: Sets Y offset from layout position in pixels.

methods.name: get_min_width
methods.description: Returns minimum width in pixels. Default 0.

methods.name: set_min_width
methods.description: Sets minimum width in pixels.

methods.name: get_min_height
methods.description: Returns minimum height in pixels. Default 0.

methods.name: set_min_height
methods.description: Sets minimum height in pixels.

methods.name: get_padding_left
methods.description: Returns left padding in pixels.

methods.name: get_padding_top
methods.description: Returns top padding in pixels.

methods.name: get_padding_right
methods.description: Returns right padding in pixels.

methods.name: get_padding_bottom
methods.description: Returns bottom padding in pixels.

methods.name: set_padding
methods.description: Sets all padding values.

methods.name: get_padding_start
methods.description: Returns start padding, respecting layout direction. LTR = left, RTL = right.

methods.name: get_padding_end
methods.description: Returns end padding, respecting layout direction. LTR = right, RTL = left.

methods.name: get_layout_direction
methods.description: Returns layout direction. Default LTR.

methods.name: set_layout_direction
methods.description: Sets layout direction (LTR or RTL).

methods.name: is_focusable
methods.description: Returns whether this view can receive focus.

methods.name: set_focusable
methods.description: Sets focusable flag.

methods.name: is_clickable
methods.description: Returns whether this view can be clicked.

methods.name: set_clickable
methods.description: Sets clickable flag.

methods.name: measure
methods.description: Triggers measure pass. Calls onMeasure() internally. Stores measured dimensions.

methods.name: get_measured_width
methods.description: Returns last measured width.

methods.name: get_measured_height
methods.description: Returns last measured height.

methods.name: layout
methods.description: Sets layout position. Calls onLayout() with changed flag.
methods.side_effects: Updates left_, top_, right_, bottom_. Sets layoutRequested_ = false.

methods.name: get_left
methods.description: Returns left coordinate.

methods.name: get_top
methods.description: Returns top coordinate.

methods.name: get_right
methods.description: Returns right coordinate.

methods.name: get_bottom
methods.description: Returns bottom coordinate.

methods.name: get_width
methods.description: Returns width (right - left).

methods.name: get_height
methods.description: Returns height (bottom - top).

methods.name: request_layout
methods.description: Marks this view as needing layout and propagates upward through ViewParent chain.
methods.side_effects: Sets layoutRequested_ = true. Calls parent->requestLayout() if parent exists.

methods.name: is_layout_requested
methods.description: Returns true if layout has been requested but not completed.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Executes draw sequence: background, content (onDraw), foreground (dispatchDraw). Returns early if GONE.

methods.name: invalidate
methods.description: Marks this view as needing redraw and propagates via onDescendantInvalidated() upward.
methods.side_effects: Calls parent->onDescendantInvalidated(this, this) if parent exists.

methods.name: dispatch_touch_event
methods.description: Delivers MotionEvent to onTouchEvent(). Returns true if consumed.

methods.name: on_touch_event
methods.description: Overridable hook for handling motion events. Default returns false.

methods.name: request_focus
methods.description: Requests focus. Returns true if focus was gained. Propagates through parent.

methods.name: clear_focus
methods.description: Clears focus from this view.

methods.name: resolve_size
methods.description: Resolves a size against a MeasureSpec. Used by WRAP_CONTENT and child measurement.

protected_methods.name: on_measure
protected_methods.description: Overridable hook for computing desired size. Default uses MeasureSpec size.

protected_methods.name: on_layout
protected_methods.description: Overridable hook for positioning. No-op in View.

protected_methods.name: on_draw
protected_methods.description: Overridable hook for content rendering. No-op in View.

protected_methods.name: dispatch_draw
protected_methods.description: Overridable hook for drawing children/foreground. No-op in View.

protected_methods.name: set_measured_dimension
protected_methods.description: Sets measured dimensions. Called by onMeasure.

ViewGroup.inheritance_style: public View, private ViewParentMixin, private ViewManagerMixin (CRTP)

constructor.name: ViewGroup
constructor.description: Default constructor. Initializes with default ViewGroup flags.

methods.name: get_child_count
methods.description: Returns the number of direct children.

methods.name: get_child_at
methods.description: Returns child at index. Returns nullptr if out of bounds.

methods.name: add_view
methods.description: Adds child with LayoutParams. Sets child's parent. Triggers layout pass.
methods.side_effects: If child has existing parent, removes from old parent first. Triggers requestLayout().

methods.name: update_view_layout
methods.description: Replaces LayoutParams on existing child. Triggers layout pass.

methods.name: remove_view
methods.description: Removes view from children. Clears parent reference. No-op if not a child.
methods.side_effects: Triggers requestLayout(). Sets view's parent to nullptr.

methods.name: measure_children
methods.description: Measures all non-GONE children with appropriate MeasureSpecs derived from LayoutParams.

methods.name: layout_children
methods.description: Positions all children within ViewGroup bounds based on LayoutParams and margins.

methods.name: dispatch_draw
methods.description: Draws background, then each visible child in z-order, then foreground. Respects clip flags.

methods.name: dispatch_touch_event
methods.description: Routes touch events: checks intercept, iterates children in z-order, falls back to own onTouchEvent.

methods.name: on_intercept_touch_event
methods.description: Overridable hook. Returns true to intercept touch events before children.

methods.name: request_disallow_intercept_touch_event
methods.description: When true, prevents parent from intercepting touch events until gesture ends.

methods.name: get_descendant_focusability
methods.description: Returns how this ViewGroup handles descendant focus.

methods.name: set_descendant_focusability
methods.description: Sets descendant focusability mode.

methods.name: is_clip_children
methods.description: Returns whether children are clipped to ViewGroup bounds.

methods.name: set_clip_children
methods.description: Sets clip children flag.

methods.name: is_clip_to_padding
methods.description: Returns whether invalidation region excludes padding.

methods.name: set_clip_to_padding
methods.description: Sets clip to padding flag.

methods.name: get_child_measure_spec
methods.description: Computes child MeasureSpec from parent spec, padding, and child LayoutParams dimension.

protected_methods.name: generate_default_layout_params
protected_methods.description: Generates default LayoutParams for newly added children. Override for custom defaults.

ViewParentMixin.description: CRTP mixin providing ViewParent interface with zero-cost static dispatch. View and ViewGroup inherit from ViewParentMixin<Self>.

methods.name: request_layout
methods.description: Propagates layout request upward through parent chain. Calls derived().on_get_parent()->request_layout().

methods.name: is_layout_requested
methods.description: Returns the layoutRequested_ flag of the derived class.

methods.name: on_descendant_invalidated
methods.description: Propagates invalidation upward. Calls parent->onDescendantInvalidated(child, target).

methods.name: on_get_parent
methods.description: Returns the parent ViewParent pointer. Implemented by derived class.

methods.name: request_child_focus
methods.description: Requests focus for a child view. Propagates upward.

methods.name: clear_child_focus
methods.description: Clears focus from a child view. Propagates upward.

methods.name: focus_search
methods.description: Searches for the nearest focusable view in the given direction.

ViewManagerMixin.description: CRTP mixin providing ViewManager interface with zero-cost static dispatch.

methods.name: add_view
methods.description: Adds view to container. Sets parent reference. Triggers layout pass.

methods.name: update_view_layout
methods.description: Updates view LayoutParams. Triggers layout pass.

methods.name: remove_view
methods.description: Removes view from container. Clears parent. Triggers layout pass.
